vulnerable_statements.reason: When the first register entry (i == 0) has uc_pre_reg_data marked DATA_EQU_PREV (the value comes from the VBIOS table), i-1 underflows. Because i is uint32_t, it wraps to 0xFFFFFFFF and the code reads out of bounds, before the start of mc_data[] or far beyond it.

suggested_fix: Only copy the previous value when a previous entry exists. Guard the DATA_EQU_PREV branch with 'i > 0' (e.g. 'if (i) ... mc_data[i] = mc_data[i-1];'), or reject the table as invalid when entry 0 is DATA_EQU_PREV. It would also help to check that table->last does not exceed the mc_data/mc_reg_address array sizes, and that j stays within the reg data block.
